english: Shall we cross the river now, or wait for the ice? The water is deep now. If we cross it, the children will sink in the water. The army is following us. If we wait, it will seize us. Then let the warriors stand at the ford, and let the women and children sit in the wagons. The frost comes quickly. Then we will wait for the ice, and they will protect us.

pie: ǵérh₂ontes nos póyḱōm h₁widʰéwh₂es gʰórdʰom gʷegʷmḗr. h₃órbʰōs HrudHénti. tóns h₁áyomesdʰh₂? h₁íh₂sōm nos póteyes ḱóymom h₁éwsont. h₁íh₂sōm suHnéwes h₂wéksonti kʷoynéh₂m-kʷe h₂isḱṓnti. nu h₁íns h₂élōmes priHṓs-kʷe nos h₁ésonti. gʷḗn toy ménos h₃reǵtóm. ḱód sedtlóy wérh₁yōh₂. wérh₁ye gʷénh₂es-kʷe tébʰye ḱóm stéh₂onti.
english: Elders, the widows of our enemies have come to our fence. The orphans are crying. Shall we take them in? Their husbands burnt our village. Their sons will grow up, and they will seek vengeance. Then let us nourish them, and they will be our own. Your mind is upright, woman. I will say this in the assembly. Speak, and the women will stand up with you.

pie: kʷíd toy príHe ḱḗr luǵróm? dʰh₁tléh₂ moy wékʷesh₂ ne ḱl̥néwt. kóryom wl̥h₁ént h₁eǵóh₂-kʷe kʷyéh₁tim wéḱm̥. polh₁éwes te h₁léwdʰeyes ḱluwént. wṓkʷs toy ḱuh₁réh₂ h₁ést. h₁wésuh₂ wékʷesh₂ ǵʰoysóns ne Hrunépti. gʷm̥dʰí méǵʰye ḱóm ph₃dʰí nókʷts dl̥h₁gʰéh₂. péh₃oh₂ ḱód-kʷe ne mérsoh₂.
english: Friend, why is your heart sad? The assembly did not listen to my words. They chose war, and I wanted peace. Many people heard you. Your voice was strong. Good words do not break spears. Come, drink with me; the night is long. I will drink, and I will not forget this.

pie: "tód h₁estu", wéwked lewkós deywós wérunos.
english: "Let this be so," said the bright god Werunos.
